name: csv-contact-cleaner
description: Clean a messy contacts CSV: fix spacing and capitalisation, normalise emails and phone numbers, merge duplicates, and write a clean file plus a file of rejected rows with reasons.

input_file.description: CSV file to clean (first row = headers). Needs at least a name and an email column.

steps.run: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_INPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8").replace(/^\uFEFF/, ""); const rows = []; let row = [], field = "", quoted = false; for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { const ch = text[i]; if (quoted) { if (ch === "\x22" && text[i + 1] === "\x22") { field += ch; i++ } else if (ch === "\x22") quoted = false; else field += ch } else if (ch === "\x22") quoted = true; else if (ch === ",") { row.push(field); field = "" } else if (ch === "\n" || ch === "\r") { if (ch === "\r" && text[i + 1] === "\n") i++; row.push(field); rows.push(row); row = []; field = "" } else field += ch } if (field || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row) } const headers = rows.shift().map(h => h.trim()); const data = rows.map((r, i) => ({ line: i + 2, values: Object.fromEntries(headers.map((h, j) => [h, (r[j] || "").trim()])) })).filter(r => Object.values(r.values).some(Boolean)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ file, headers, rows: data }))'

node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const find = re => d.headers.find(h => re.test(h.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, ""))); const col = { name: find(/^(fullname|name|contact)$/), email: find(/^(email|mail|emailaddress)$/), phone: find(/^(phone|mobile|tel|telephone)$/), company: find(/^(company|organisation|organization|org)$/), city: find(/^(city|town)$/) }; if (!col.name || !col.email) throw new Error("Could not find name/email columns in: " + d.headers.join(", ")); const nice = s => { s = s.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); return s && (s === s.toLowerCase() || s === s.toUpperCase()) ? s.toLowerCase().replace(/(^|[\s\-])(\p{L})/gu, (m, a, b) => a + b.toUpperCase()) : s }; const phone = s => { const t = s.replace(/\(0\)/g, ""); const digits = t.replace(/\D/g, ""); if (digits.length < 7) return { value: "", bad: s.trim() !== "" }; return { value: (t.trim().startsWith("+") ? "+" : "") + digits, bad: false } }; const byEmail = new Map(); const rejected = []; let merged = 0; const fixes = { name: 0, email: 0, phone: 0 }; for (const r of d.rows) { const v = r.values; const rawName = v[col.name] || ""; const rawEmail = v[col.email] || ""; const name = nice(rawName); const email = rawEmail.toLowerCase().trim(); const ph = phone(col.phone ? v[col.phone] || "" : ""); const reasons = []; if (!name) reasons.push("missing name"); if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[a-z]{2,}$/.test(email)) reasons.push("invalid email \u201c" + rawEmail + "\u201d"); if (reasons.length) { rejected.push({ line: r.line, name: rawName, email: rawEmail, reasons: reasons.join("; ") }); continue } if (name !== rawName) fixes.name++; if (email !== rawEmail) fixes.email++; const contact = { name, email, phone: ph.value, company: col.company ? (v[col.company] || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ") : "", city: col.city ? nice(v[col.city] || "") : "", notes: ph.bad ? "phone unreadable: " + v[col.phone] : "" }; if (ph.value && ph.value !== (v[col.phone] || "")) fixes.phone++; const prev = byEmail.get(email); if (prev) { merged++; for (const k of Object.keys(contact)) if (!prev[k] && contact[k]) prev[k] = contact[k] } else byEmail.set(email, contact) } const clean = [...byEmail.values()].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)); console.log(JSON.stringify({ input: d.rows.length, clean, rejected, merged, fixes }))'

node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const r = JSON.parse(process.env.RESULT); const dir = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OUTPUT_DIR.replace(/^~(?=/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true }); const csv = v => /[",
]/.test(String(v)) ? "\x22" + String(v).replace(/"/g, "\x22\x22") + "\x22" : String(v); const toCsv = (cols, rows) => [cols.join(","), ...rows.map(x => cols.map(c => csv(x[c] == null ? "" : x[c])).join(","))].join("
") + "
"; const cleanFile = path.join(dir, "contacts.clean.csv"); const rejFile = path.join(dir, "contacts.rejected.csv"); fs.writeFileSync(cleanFile, toCsv(["name", "email", "phone", "company", "city", "notes"], r.clean)); fs.writeFileSync(rejFile, toCsv(["line", "name", "email", "reasons"], r.rejected)); const lines = ["🧹 Cleaned " + r.input + " rows → " + r.clean.length + " contacts", "• merged " + r.merged + " duplicate(s) by email", "• fixed " + r.fixes.name + " names, " + r.fixes.email + " emails, " + r.fixes.phone + " phone numbers", "• rejected " + r.rejected.length + " row(s):"]; r.rejected.forEach(x => lines.push("   line " + x.line + ": " + x.reasons)); lines.push("", "Clean file: " + cleanFile, "Rejected:   " + rejFile); console.log(lines.join("
"))'
